title: Construction of the exterior dual determinant pairing
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, $M^\vee=\mathcal Hom(M,\mathcal O_X)$ its internal dual [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and $n\geq0$. For the sheafified exterior powers and wedges of local sections [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there exists a morphism $f:\bigwedge^n M^\vee\to(\bigwedge^n M)^\vee$. For every open $U$, every $a_i\in M(U)$ and $\varphi_j\in M^\vee(U)$, its value on $\varphi_1\wedge\cdots\wedge\varphi_n$, evaluated on $a_1\wedge\cdots\wedge a_n$, is $\det(\varphi_j(a_i))$. No local freeness assumption is needed.

proof.text: For each open choose the uniquely characterized upstream alternating family on exteriorPower from exterior_dual_pairing_local. Compose it with the linear map on sections of dualMap(exteriorSheafIsoExteriorPower.hom), using LinearMap.compAlternatingMap. This gives an alternating family of functionals on exteriorSheaf. The comparison hom preserves pure wedges, so the upstream formula gives its determinant formula on every subopen. Prove compatibility under restriction by exteriorSheaf_dual_ext_compat: for W→V→U both sides evaluate to the same determinant, since internal Hom restriction identifies their components definitionally.

Apply exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv on each open. These linear maps form a morphism from the exterior presheaf of the internal dual to the internal dual of the exterior sheaf. Prove naturality using exteriorPower.linearMap_ext, the pure-wedge characterization of exteriorSheafRestriction and the restriction identity from the preceding step. Here the upstream extensionality theorem is transported through the canonical wedge-preserving isomorphism exteriorSheafIsoExteriorPower, as exteriorSheaf_dual_ext_compat; this preserves the original exteriorSheaf statement.

Extend the presheaf morphism through the sheafification adjunction to obtain f. The hom-equivalence apply_symm_apply identity says its composite with the unit is the original presheaf morphism. Evaluate on the pure wedge of φ, then on the pure wedge of a, and use the local determinant formula at the identity subopen. This proves exactly the original existence statement and formula.

B4 (2026-10-20): consume the upstream alternating-family theorem on exteriorPower and transport with dualMap of the canonical comparison; LinearMap.compAlternatingMap preserves alternation and the hom-wedge formula proves the same evaluation identity.

lean.statement:
theorem exterior_dual_pairing_exists (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f :
    (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf (Scheme.Modules.dual M) n) ⟶
      Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf M n),
    ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U))
      (φ : Fin n → (Scheme.Modules.dual M).val.obj (op U)),
      (f.val.app (op U) (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection
        (Scheme.Modules.dual M) n U φ)).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
        (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection M n U a) =
      (Matrix.of fun i j ↦
        (show X.presheaf.obj (op U) from
          (φ j).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (a i))).det
